name: Candidate Dossier Schema
description: Schema for storing candidate idea dossiers with all evidence and analysis

id.description: Unique identifier for this candidate (e.g., candidate_video-automation_01)

nicheLabel.description: Label for the niche this candidate addresses

problemSummary.description: Summary of the problem this candidate addresses

comparableProducts.description: List of comparable products in the market

tractionEvidenceRefs.description: References to normalized evidence records showing traction

pricingEvidenceRefs.description: References to normalized evidence records showing pricing/willingness-to-pay

acquisitionEvidenceRefs.description: References to normalized evidence records showing acquisition channels

complexityNotes.description: Notes about build complexity and maintenance burden

maintainabilityNotes.description: Notes about maintainability and operational burden

promotionRationale.description: Explanation of why this candidate was promoted/rejected

lastUpdated.description: When this dossier was last updated

example.problemSummary: Content creators spend too much time manually editing videos for multiple platforms
example.complexityNotes: Can leverage existing AI video APIs, core value is workflow automation
example.acquisitionNotes: SEO for 'video editing automation', YouTube tutorials, Reddit communities
example.maintainabilityNotes: Low operational burden, API-based, no complex infrastructure
example.promotionRationale: Strong traction evidence from similar tools, clear wedge in platform optimization, low build complexity with AI APIs
